features.transformation: A T0 full-coverage ballot table sets list support to 1 for registered and 0 for rejected/absent only after table-completeness certification.
features.missingness: NA until authoritative full-coverage table is certified.

features.transformation: Authoritative list rank determines candidate order and eligible next-candidate identity only.
features.missingness: NA; never inferred from media ordering.

features.transformation: Exact authoritative birthdate replaces the exchangeable-age prior only for statutory binding ties involving that candidate rank.
features.missingness: NA retains the frozen exchangeable-age prior; no approximate age is accepted.

features.transformation: A verified legal withdrawal/disqualification changes eligible rank order from its effective timestamp; it does not receive a vote-share coefficient.
features.missingness: False only when an authoritative final roster explicitly remains valid; otherwise NA.

features.transformation: Canonical alliance/list identity is used for legal ballot support and party-output attribution under a separately published mapping.
features.missingness: NA; informal cooperation is not an alliance.

features.definition: Number of registered candidates who held a 2021 House seat for the same party and same certified local constituency.
features.missingness: NA unless both historical incumbent identity and current roster coverage pass.

features.definition: Number of registered candidates who held a 2021 House seat for the same party in a different certified constituency.
features.missingness: NA unless identities and both territories are resolved.

features.definition: Registered candidate count previously elected in 2021 under another party and now authoritatively registered under the focal party.
features.missingness: NA unless switch and registration satisfy critical double-entry.

features.definition: 2021 focal-party incumbent count registered in 2026 under another party or authoritatively absent from the final roster.
features.missingness: NA until authoritative final roster coverage passes.

features.definition: Registered candidate count holding a verified communal, provincial/prefectural or regional executive office at the evidence cutoff, represented as separate frozen office-tier columns.
features.missingness: NA for unresolved office identity; no press description such as influential/notable is accepted.

features.definition: Registered candidate count holding an objectively named national or regional party office at cutoff.
features.missingness: NA unless an official party organ or corroborated professional source identifies the office and dates.

features.definition: Count of explicit, attributable endorsements by a frozen endorser class; attendance, praise or inferred support is excluded.
features.missingness: Zero only after complete scanning of the frozen source universe for the cutoff; otherwise NA.

features.definition: Verified named office-holder/candidate defections in minus out, with each person counted once and mapped to the effective territory.
features.missingness: NA for anonymous blocs or unverifiable claims.

features.definition: Objectively timestamped formal campaign/list launch satisfying the source rule.
features.missingness: NA unless the source universe scan is complete.

features.definition: Formal action by a named competent authority; allegation, commentary or generic controversy is excluded.
features.missingness: NA unless a T0 action exists or a complete source scan certifies none found.

features.definition: Verified death or legally relevant incapacity, with mechanical effect only when authoritative roster consequences are published.
features.missingness: False only for a validated active final roster; otherwise NA.

historical_calibration_contract.feature_creation_cutoff: Each historical feature must use only information publicly available before the relevant historical election cutoff.
selection_metric_order: vote Energy Score improvement versus persistence
historical_calibration_contract.mandatory_failure: A feature failing coverage/support remains exactly zero in F0. No hand-set sign or magnitude is permitted.
historical_calibration_contract.effect_cap: Norm cap at the fit-transition empirical 90th percentile of absolute persistence residuals, published before 2026 feature application.
